notes.title: DreamHack – Galactic Tanks VR – Spotlight
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32296992/1e0e1091e1fda39e844c8a428cf63f79f953189b.jpg[/img]

Galactic Tanks is great free-to-play MMO game with real-time PvP battles dedicated to armored machines for players all over the world. Throw yourself into intense battles against other players. Customize your heavy fantastic tank by combining guns, hulls and protective modules, and face smart AI and real players in different game modes. Decide to run on for fast attack or stay back and make your strategy to destroy enemy in the silent.

Here you can see progress of development as raw gameplay in 3D and VR:
https://youtu.be/__eiO_lTQvM

notes.title: Join us at Pixel Connect and Pixel Heaven 2018, Warsaw, Poland
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32296992/36a04524c076c264064b22c1c0ad0e347b545e88.jpg[/img]

Join us at Pixel Connect 2018 http://pixel-connect.com and Pixel Heaven 2018 https://www.pixelheavenfest.com at 7th and 8th-10th of June 2018 in Warsaw, Poland.

Pixel Heaven 2018 is the sixth edition of the largest event in Europe for fans of electronic entertainment who still remember the early days of 8/16-bit computers, and more, It is also Poland’s biggest celebration of independent game developers. Pixel Connect is a conference and after-party dedicated to B2B.

Come and play Galactic Tanks in VR! You are very welcome 🙂

We are SUPER excited to invite you to join us at DreamHack at 1-3rd of June 2018 at Austin, Texas ! DreamHack is the world’s largest digital festival. You can read more at https://dreamhack.com .

notes.title: Current task: Implementing GUI and creating lobby
notes.content:
Our current mission is to implement GUI framework and create lobby where you can select an massive tank and start new game. Matchmaking will be next step upfront.
